positions.title: Senior Software engineer(Diagnostic and Drivers)
positions.description:
Intel FM3000 10G or IXF1110 1G Platform Embedded Software Development for a Network Gateway.

Experience in Embedded Software Development in a Linux processor Hardware platform.  
•	Develop Hardware Drivers from the external port level to the EZchip level.
•	Debug using GDB.
•	Bring up and debugging the actual system by using a logic analyzer or oscilloscope.

positions.title: Senior Software engineer
positions.description:
Sr. Diagnostic/Driver Software Engineer

	Development of a RF Diagnostic Platform
•	Develop an environment where the RF engineers can write a script of commands (internal commands specified by the RF engineers).   The parser in this environment breaks the internal scripting commands to lower level write or read commands.
•	Develop a driver that converts these lower level commands to handshaking signals between the processor and the RF chip.  The signals are similar to the standard I2C signals.


	Development of a communication network between subsystems.
•	Develop Inter-processor communication using standard I2c.
•	Develop in a non-RTOS environment.


	Development of the Interface between the hdmi driver and wireless MAC
•	Develop Video/Audio Interface
•	Develop Communication Protocol based on WiHD 1.1

positions.title: Senior Software engineer(Diagnostic and Drivers)
positions.description:
1) Hw Drivers Bring Up and Development 

* Bringup and Development in MIPS/Intel XSCALE/Intel IXP424 Hardware Platform.

* Bringup and Development of the following drivers:
     - PCI Bus Intel 82559 Ethernet Controller/Device
     - Intel Strata Flash Device
     - I2C Eeprom
     - Real Time Clock(RTC) Device
     - Software Watch Dog Device
     - TransSwitch MAC for Layer 2 MAC for a Multiple Switch  
       Controller.
     - 10/100 bps and Fiber Optic Phy Device
 
RF Bringup and Development of the ATE(Automation for RF Cal and Testing) for wireless characterization and manufacturing

     * Automation of the following Calibration using Spectrum 
       Analyzer
            - Calibration of the Synthesizer Reference Clock
            - Calibration of the Transmit Gain
            - Calibration of the Receive AGC Gain.

      *Automation for the following Measurement using the 
       Spectrum Analyzer.
            - Measurement of the Transmit Phase Noise.
            - Measurement of the Transmit ACPR.
            - Measurement of the Rx SNR
            - Measurement of Tx/Rx Spurious Emission

2) Development of a Testing Automation for a Wireless IF Card

* Automation includes the following:
     - Check the data integrity of the Flash Device
     - Check the functionity of the Ethernet Device
     - Check the data integrity of the DDR Memory Device
     - Check the radio telemetry
     - Check the wireless throughput of the card
     - Check the wireless EVM measurement.
     - Check the cable loss measurement.

3) Wireless Media Access Control(MAC) for Wireless Network Testing

* ARQ(Automatic Retry Q).  Test Algorithm for retrying bad packets.

* Dynamic Adaptation.  Test Algorithm for dynamic  modulation(QPSK or 16QAM).

* DES.  Test Algorithm for Network Layer 2 encryption and decryption.

positions.title: Senior Software engineer(Diagnostic and Drivers)
positions.description:
*	Participated in the complete software lifecycle process, which included design, development, implementation, testing, documentation and release of Diagnostic, Calibration and Verification software. This led to product final acceptance and additional orders by key customers thereafter.

*	Worked with hardware engineers to develop Diagnostic, Calibration and Verification specifications, architecture and strategies as part of the design phase.  This ensured comprehensive diagnostic and verification test coverage for new functionality and products.

*	Interfaced with both hardware and software development groups to successfully integrate Diagnostics, Calibration and Verification software for the complete LTX tester product line.  This facilitated the creation of functional and user friendly software.

*	Monitored the results of Diagnostic and Verification tests at Manufacturing and Customer sites for accuracy, repeatability and robustness.  This lead to the efficient repair and return of LTX tester product line parts to customers and decreased tester downtime

*	Debug System boards using a logic analyzer or oscilloscope.
